proof_scope: Twenty-nine adversarial Tau/Ask cases that try to launder vague Ask requests, incomplete verifier DAGs, model prose claims, fake artifacts, unverified commands, reviewer lies, join laundering, recovery laundering, mocked proof, and missing human acceptance through Tau.

claims.proves: The retained fixture runs the Ask Tau-DAG front door and Tau project-DAG executions, then reads status/failure codes from generated artifacts for 29 adversarial trust-gate cases.
claims.does_not_prove: External provider honesty, browser response quality, human semantic approval, or full Tau release readiness. Browser/API handlers are not contacted by the vague Ask preflight case.

what_was_exercised: local commands declared in the fixture manifest
what_remains_unverified: semantic correctness, live services, LLM judge behavior, and release readiness
